# equinix_fabric_asns (Data Source)

Fabric V4 API compatible data resource that allows users to search for Equinix Autonomous System Numbers (ASNs) with pagination details.

Additional Documentation:
* API: https://docs.equinix.com/api-catalog/fabricv4/#tag/ASNs



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filter` (Attributes) Filters for the Data Source Search Request (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))

### Optional

- `pagination` (Attributes) Pagination details for the returned ASNs list (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pagination))
- `sort` (Attributes) Sort criteria for the Data Source Search Request (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sort))

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) Returned list of ASN objects (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the resource

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `operator` (String) Operator to use on your filtered field with the values given. One of: [=, !=, IN, NOT IN, LIKE, ILIKE, BETWEEN, >, >=, <, <=, ~*]
- `property` (String) Field name to use on filters, e.g. "/project/projectId", "/uuid", "/state", "/type"
- `values` (List of String) The values that you want to apply the property+operator combination to in order to filter your data search


<a id="nestedatt--pagination"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pagination`

Optional:

- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of search results returned per page. Number must be between 1 and 100, and the default is 20
- `offset` (Number) Index of the first item returned in the response. The default is 0

Read-Only:

- `next` (String) The URL relative to the next item in the response
- `previous` (String) The URL relative to the previous item in the response
- `total` (Number) The total number of ASNs available to the user making the request


<a id="nestedatt--sort"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sort`

Optional:

- `direction` (String) The sorting direction. Can be one of: [DESC, ASC], Defaults to ASC
- `property` (String) The property name to use in sorting, e.g. "/state". Allowed values: /changeLog/createdDateTime, /uuid, /state, /project/projectId, /type


<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `assets` (Attributes List) Assets (services) the ASN is attached to (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--assets))
- `change` (Attributes) Current state of the latest change on the ASN (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--change))
- `change_log` (Attributes) Details of the last change on the ASN (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--change_log))
- `href` (String) Equinix auto generated URI to the ASN
- `location` (Attributes) Location of the ASN (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--location))
- `number` (Number) Autonomous System Number
- `ownership_challenge_details` (Attributes) Details of the ASN ownership challenge (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--ownership_challenge_details))
- `project` (Attributes) Project the ASN belongs to (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--project))
- `range` (String) Range of the ASN. One of: 16_BIT, 32_BIT
- `rir_region` (String) Regional Internet Registry region of the ASN. One of: AFRINIC, APNIC, ARIN, LACNIC, RIPE_NCC
- `state` (String) State of the ASN. One of: REQUESTED, PROVISIONING, PENDING, PROVISIONED, ATTACHED, FAILED, PROVISIONING_FAILED, DEPROVISIONING, DEPROVISIONING_FAILED, DEPROVISIONED
- `uuid` (String) Equinix-assigned unique identifier for the ASN record

<a id="nestedatt--data--assets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.assets`

Read-Only:

- `announcing_metro` (String) Metro announcing the ASN
- `ip_blocks` (Attributes List) IP blocks announced with the ASN (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--assets--ip_blocks))
- `service` (Attributes) Service the ASN is attached to (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--assets--service))
- `uuid` (String) Asset identifier

<a id="nestedatt--data--assets--ip_blocks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.assets.ip_blocks`

Read-Only:

- `href` (String) URI to the IP block
- `type` (String) IP block reference type. One of: IPV4_IP_BLOCK, IPV6_IP_BLOCK
- `uuid` (String) IP block identifier


<a id="nestedatt--data--assets--service"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.assets.service`

Read-Only:

- `href` (String) URI to the service
- `type` (String) Service type. One of: IA
- `uuid` (String) Service identifier



<a id="nestedatt--data--change"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.change`

Read-Only:

- `href` (String) URI to the change resource


<a id="nestedatt--data--change_log"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.change_log`

Read-Only:

- `created_date_time` (String) Creation date and time
- `deleted_date_time` (String) Deletion date and time
- `updated_date_time` (String) Last update date and time


<a id="nestedatt--data--location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.location`

Read-Only:

- `ibx` (String) IBX site code (deprecated)
- `metro_code` (String) Metro code
- `metro_href` (String) URI to the metro
- `metro_name` (String) Metro name
- `region` (String) Region of the metro


<a id="nestedatt--data--ownership_challenge_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.ownership_challenge_details`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Ownership challenge type. One of: LOA, RPKI


<a id="nestedatt--data--project"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.project`

Read-Only:

- `project_id` (String) Project identifier
